items.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Monk used to play there, and what’s her name, Carmen McRae, she used to sing there... And sometimes she would be there and I’d play behind here on something you know.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe, and I’m very pleased to have Joe Wilder with us. Thank you very much for coming.
Oh, thank you for inviting me, Monk. I’m sorry you had to track me down.
Well you had such a busy schedule here I feel like I should talk real fast.
